signal: Linarc launched a free 21-day full-platform trial and free lifetime scheduling access in October 2025, and partnered with BigRentz in June 2025 to cut jobsite delays.

email.body1:
Luis, saw Linarc opened a free full-platform trial and lifetime scheduling access, plus the BigRentz partnership.

A product-led push like that usually pulls in more in-market contractors than a sales team can follow up with before interest fades, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Linarc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Luis, quick follow-up for Linarc.

When a free trial drives volume, reps burn time on research and CRM instead of the contractors most likely to convert, so the best-fit accounts get a generic touch. Tightening emails to 75-100 words alone tends to lift responses about 67%, and most teams never hit that at scale.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to your top 3 target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body3:
Luis, last bit of proof for Linarc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Linarc's reply rate likely compares to other construction-tech teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Luis, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling trial follow-up without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product-led push is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Linarc either way.
